make_atari_env: create an Atari environment with frame skipping and optional no-op reset using make_atari
wrap_deepmind_env: wrap an Atari environment with DeepMind-style preprocessing including frame warping and reward clipping
wrap_pytorch_env: wrap a gym environment to swap image axes for PyTorch channel-first format
get_env_type: get the environment type and canonical env ID from a gym environment ID string
review_EpisodicLifeEnv: review the EpisodicLifeEnv wrapper that makes loss of life equivalent to end of episode
